title: Missing Refund Option for Claude Code Sustained Outage
body:
There are at least 50 if not 100 open issues that Claude Code does not work anymore with Pro and Max subscriptions, because login fails with missing api key.

I cannot use the latest version, need to downgrade to 1.0.67, then try again a later version that _maybe_ Claude Code was fixed, and this for a Max subscription?

This is not acceptable, it's 100% downtime from a customer perspective.

Anthropic should refund all Pro and Max customers for each day since 1.0.68 was published, until the outage is resolved. It is resolved when a Claude Code version in released that actually works.

Make an option available to request a refund on the website.

Recommend removing the "support chatbot" from the 1990s and utilize an LLM to process the requests.
author: teeay-dev
